source: source-bound synthetic or explicitly permitted producer snapshot
customer_receipts: independent CUSTOMER_RECEIPT evidence; absence is UNKNOWN, not 0 or inferred dispatch

semantics.net: INVOICE adds, CREDIT subtracts at each own invoice date; no ORDER_DATE or ledger fallback
semantics.OTIF: full original promised quantity dispatched by original deadline; late completion never repairs history
semantics.fanout: document, order, shipment composite keys unique; no receipts or returns join into billed net
semantics.rights: metadata/descriptors/caller roles are not authority; operation allowed only under a separately trusted source/snapshot grant

scope_nonclaims: not a new private source permission
not universal ERP or second vendor validation
